title: S-Corp Election Break-Even Modeler
description: S-Corp election break-even modeler: from net self-employment income, a reasonable W-2 salary share and an annual admin cost, compute the sole-proprietor SE tax, the S-Corp payroll tax, the savings net of admin cost, the five-year saving, the grid break-even income, and a QBI section 199A trade-off output weighing payroll-tax saved against the 20% deduction value lost on wages paid. 2026: SS wage base $184,500 with cap logic, SS 12.4%, Medicare 2.9% uncapped, and the 92.35% SE factor on net earnings from self-employment only, never W-2 wages (IRS Topic 554). Ported from ApexLogics display_number #111 (AL-118), CC BY 4.0.

net_se_income.description: Net self-employment income in dollars for the year. Default 150000 when absent.

reasonable_salary_pct.description: Reasonable W-2 salary as a percent of net SE income, 0-100; the compute divides by 100. Default 50.

annual_admin_cost.description: Annual S-Corp accounting and payroll admin cost in dollars. Typical band $1,500-$3,000/yr; outside values honored and flagged. Default 3000.

owner_health_premium_annual.description: Owner health premium, annual dollars. Echoed, unused by the compute (DIFFERS D2). Default 0.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Excluded from the tax math (DIFFERS D1); selects only the section 199A threshold caveat flag. Default single.

mcp_tool_definition.name: model_scorp_break_even
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model the S-Corp election break-even: sole-prop SE tax vs S-Corp payroll tax on a reasonable W-2 salary share, net of annual admin cost, with the grid break-even income and a QBI section 199A trade-off (payroll-tax saved vs the 20% deduction value lost on wages paid). 2026: SS wage base $184,500 with cap logic, SS 12.4%, Medicare 2.9% uncapped, and the 92.35% SE factor on net earnings from self-employment only, never W-2 wages (IRS Topic 554).

net_se_income.description: Net self-employment income in dollars for the year. Default 150000 when absent.

reasonable_salary_pct.description: Reasonable W-2 salary as a percent of net SE income, 0-100; the compute divides by 100. Default 50.

annual_admin_cost.description: Annual S-Corp accounting and payroll admin cost in dollars. Typical band $1,500-$3,000/yr; outside values honored and flagged. Default 3000.

owner_health_premium_annual.description: Owner health premium, annual dollars. Echoed, unused by the compute (DIFFERS D2). Default 0.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Excluded from the tax math (DIFFERS D1); selects only the section 199A threshold caveat flag. Default single.

output_schema.description: output_payload: verdict (SCORP_WINS when net_annual_savings >= 0), net_se_income, reasonable_salary_pct, annual_admin_cost, filing_status, owner_health_premium_annual, reasonable_w2_salary, distribution, sole_prop_se_tax, scorp_payroll_tax (full-wage FICA: SS capped at $184,500, Medicare 2.9% uncapped), se_tax_savings, net_annual_savings, five_year_savings, break_even_income (first point of the 500-step grid, null when never reached), half_se_tax_deduction and scorp_employer_tax (diagnostics), qbi_199a_income, qbi_199a_deduction_tentative (20%), qbi_199a_value_at_risk (wages at the adjudicated 19.8% effective rate), net_annual_savings_qbi_adjusted, qbi_adjusted_break_even_income, caveats (flag-mirror advisories), scope_note.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: net_se_income, reasonable_salary_pct, annual_admin_cost, owner_health_premium_annual, filing_status.
author: PostOakLabs

caveats: QBI-adjusted break-even never reached: the QBI value given up outweighs the payroll-tax saving at this salary share.
output_example.scope_note: Deterministic 2026 model, not tax advice. The 92.35% SE factor is applied to net earnings from self-employment only, never to W-2 wages (IRS Topic 554) — the port corrects Apex #111 on this point by adjudication of record. The 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax above $200K single / $250K MFJ is NOT modeled. The QBI section 199A trade-off values wages at the adjudicated 19.8% effective rate, flags (from net income as a taxable-income proxy) the $201,775 single / $403,500 MFJ threshold and phase-out band, and cannot see SSTB status, which disallows the deduction inside the band. Break-even is the first point of a 500-step grid, within one step of the continuous break-even.
